Pre-Order your own Diamond Plushie now!

Pre-Orders start October 1st!

Welcome back to a place where geometry meets dread.

In Save The Shapes: Chapter 2, the Shapes thought their troubles were finally over...

They were wrong.

Diamond is back, and this time it’s personal.

With old friends returning and some new Shapes joining the chaos, you’ll have to survive new dangers, strange places, and whatever Diamond has planned for his revenge.

  • It’s quirkier.
  • It’s bigger.
  • It’s REVENGE.
  • It’s SHAPES.

Can you save them... again?

Characters:

  • Ricky Rectangle
  • Sally Square
  • Cory Circle
  • Ovy Oval
  • Timmy Triangle
  • Haley Heart
  • Sammy Star
  • Olly Octagon
  • Rhonny Rhombus
  • (...) Diamond

I recommend publishing your game on IndieDB. IndieDB is one of the largest indie video game websites on the internet. Here are a few tips:

  1. Constantly update your page. IndieDB values consistency. Every time you update your page, it will likely place you around the top 1000 in popularity. At first, when the page is brand new, it will probably rank very high, but it will eventually go down.
  2. When you create your page on the platform, it will probably be published on ModDB too. ModDB is IndieDB’s sister site; it has been operating since 2002, while IndieDB was founded in 2010.
  3. You can add a direct link to your itch.io on your page. That way, when someone visits, they can go straight to the game. That would be all, bye
